title: FT! ( OP script free gui MoonHub )
features:
[Info]
[+] Version tag (v1.0.0)
[+] Join Discord section (auto-fetch name/description/icon)
[+] Copy invite link button

[Farm]
[+] Auto Start Fishing
[+] Instant Fishing
[+] Auto Sell All
[+] Sell Delay (seconds)
[+] Choose a Fishing Zone (dropdown)
[+] Teleport to Selected Zone
[+] Save Current Position
[+] Teleport to Saved Position
[+] Teleport & Freeze at Saved Pos (loop)
[+] Teleport & Freeze at Selected Zone (loop)

[Market]
[+] Auto Sell All Fish (market)

[Shop]
[+] Select Rod (dropdown)
[+] Auto Buy Selected Rod
[+] Select Boat (dropdown)
[+] Buy Selected Boat
[+] Auto Buy Selected Boat
[+] Select Bait (dropdown)
[+] Buy Selected Bait
[+] Auto Buy Selected Bait

[Teleport]
[+] Islands: Select Island (dropdown)
[+] Teleport to Island
[+] Machines: Select Machine (dropdown)
[+] Teleport to Machine
[+] NPCs: Select NPC (dropdown)
[+] Teleport to NPC

[Player]
[+] Player Selection (dropdown)
[+] Refresh Player List (notify)
[+] Spectate Selected Player
[+] Stop Spectating
[+] Teleport to Selected Player

[Movement]
[+] No Clip
[+] Infinite Jump
[+] Fly (WASD + Space/Shift)
[+] Walk Speed (slider)
[+] Jump Power (slider)

[ESP]
[+] Player Chams (Highlight)
[+] Name ESP (BillboardGui)

[Config]
[+] Config Name input
[+] All Configs (dropdown)
[+] Refresh Dropdown
[+] Save Config
[+] Load Config

[Settings]
[+] FPS Cap (slider)
[+] Theme selector (Dark, Light, Rose, Plant, Red, Indigo, Sky, Violet, Amber, Emerald, Midnight, Crimson, Monokai Pro, Cotton Candy, Rainbow)
[+] Set Theme
[+] UI Transparency toggle

[Background Loops / Systems]
[+] Auto-buy loops (Rod, Boat, Bait)
[+] Auto-sell loops (Market / Sell All)
[+] WalkSpeed & JumpPower enforcer
[+] Fly engine (BodyVelocity/BodyGyro)
[+] ESP maintenance (add/remove on player join/leave)

[UI]
[+] WindUI window with draggable gradient Open button
[+] Sections: Main, Teleport, Utilities, Options, Info
